load_dataclass_from_json: load a list of dataclass instances from a JSON file using the load_dataclass function
load_dataclass_binary: load a list of dataclass instances from a binary JSON file handle using load_dataclass with binary=True
resolve_optional_type: check whether a type annotation is equivalent to typing.Optional using the _resolve_optional helper
unwrap_optional_type: strip an Optional wrapper from a type annotation using the _unwrap_type helper
get_dataclass_field_default: get the default value for a dataclass field using the _get_dataclass_field_default helper
